stories.title: Flintshire roadworks round-up: what’s closed and where this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire are facing road closures and temporary traffic lights at dozens of locations this week, with two roads in Ewloe closed overnight by the same contractor. stories.title: Flintshire tops Wales for pace of new house building, official data reveals
stories.summary: Flintshire had the highest rate of new house building starts of any local authority in Wales in 2025-26, according to Welsh Government figures published this month. For every 1,000 homes already standing in the county, six new ones were started during the year. That was twice the Wales-wide rate of three new homes per 1,000
